title: C++ missing in docs, linux dependencies for Ubuntu

labels.name: C-Docs
labels.description: An addition or correction to our documentation

labels.name: D-Trivial
labels.description: Nice and easy! A great choice to get started with Bevy

body:
**Bevy version**
0.4.0
The release number or commit hash of the version you're using.

**Operating system & version**
Ubuntu 20.04
Ex: Windows 10, Ubuntu 18.04, iOS 14.

**What you did**
Followed instructions in [linux dependencies](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/master/docs/linux_dependencies.md)
Fixed it by installing this: `sudo apt install build-essential`

**What you expected to happen**
bevy to build when following instructions in the docs


**What actually happened**
Build failed because c++ was not installed
